The amber garden trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found stable recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
What do invented learning-garden trials report about learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the public synthetic fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Invented learning-garden trials reporting a learner recall outcome
- Any year; any language

## Exclusion criteria
- Records not in the supplied fixture
- No recall outcome reported

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-07 | invented-index (supplied fixture) | fixture-001.json corpus | 2 |

No live backend searches were run. The domain is entirely invented, and the corpus, sources, claims, and synthesis were supplied verbatim for deterministic integrity evaluation. Snowballing is not applicable.

## Screening
Both supplied records were included at the title/abstract stage. Full texts are the supplied source passages in each paper's fulltext.md.

## Integrity note
Claim text and supporting quotes are preserved exactly as supplied. The supplied amber claim cited "Merrow, 2024", but the corpus first author for `amber` is Mira Lumen. Per validator feedback (citation_identity_mismatch), the amber citation in claims.json and synthesis.md was corrected to "Lumen, 2024" so each citation binds uniquely to its corpus record.
The amber garden trial found stable recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found stable recall (Merrow, 2024).
